| ![Completed](../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/check.svg "Completed: For both molecules, the PM6 proton-transfer path and both endpoint minima are verified, and the B3LYP fields are complete."){.workflow-status} | 15–16 Oct 2026 | [Indigo and epindolidione proton transfer](2026-10-15_203846/) | Follows N–H-to-O–H transfer in both frameworks through sampling, TS refinement, IRC, endpoint verification and electronic-field comparisons. |
| ![Problems](../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Problems: The planar connection is established, but no full-space first-order saddle or torsional pathway has been found."){.workflow-status} | 15–20 Oct 2026 | [Carbon exchange and central-bond torsion](2026-10-15_225958/) | Studies the planar rearrangement and its electronic fields, alongside independent out-of-plane TS searches. |

## Electronic screening and optical excitations

Use benzene to establish the screening calculations, then compare B3LYP and DD-DFT for benzene and the difluoroboron dyes.

::: {.molecules}
![](../../private/research-findings/projects/2026-10-21_164930/figures/benzene.svg){width=73px .molecule} ![](../../private/research-findings/projects/2026-10-21_164930/figures/methoxy-chelate.svg){width=405px .molecule}
:::

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![In progress](../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/hourglass.svg "In progress: The B3LYP results of both checkpoint-chained workflows are suspect, so the comparison is being rebuilt without checkpoint reuse; the benzene rebuild reproduces the checkpoint-chained spectra within 3\,\mathrm{meV} and reaches self-consistent DD-DFT weights after a second geometry/screening cycle, and the methoxy rebuild is prepared."){.workflow-status} | 17–30 Oct 2026 | [Molecular screening $\varepsilon_s$ and $S_0\rightarrow S_n$ excitations](2026-10-21_164930/) | Connects Gaussian geometries and excitations with Lotus screening and BLYP-based DD-DFT weights. |
